issues: Ledger imports from '@noble/hashes/sha2.js' and '@noble/hashes/utils.js' are using ES module file extensions (.js) which Jest cannot import as ES modules without proper configuration. This causes test suite failures (e.g., m11.test.ts) with "Must use import to load ES Module" errors. The code should import from the package entry points without the .js extension (e.g., import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha2'; import { bytesToHex, utf8ToBytes } from '@noble/hashes/utils';) or adjust Jest's transformation to handle .js extensions.
src/lib/ledgerVerification.ts references undefined names 'bytesToHex', 'sha256', and 'utf8ToBytes' because they are not imported. This leads to TypeScript compilation errors.
src/lib/backup.ts calls verifyLedger(store, obj.ledger) with two arguments, but verifyLedger only accepts one argument (store). This mismatched signature causes a TypeScript error.

Planned files such as src/screens/MileageHistoryScreen.tsx, src/screens/VerifyExportScreen.tsx, src/ui_flow.json, src/components/ui/HistoryList.tsx, and src/components/ui/VerificationStatus.tsx are missing, violating the requirement to update UI flow and add History views.
Export verification functions (e.g., verifyExportCode) are imported in tests but not implemented or exported in src/lib/exportVerification.ts, causing missing module errors.
Various requirements (R8, R11, R13, R52) are unimplemented or partially implemented, as indicated by missing code and tests failing.
feedback: The ledger implementation has critical import and type errors, missing functions, and UI components. Fix the import paths for @noble/hashes, add missing imports in ledgerVerification, correct the backup verifyLedger call signature, implement all planned files, and ensure all listed requirements are fully satisfied before re-running tests.
